title: Karpathy LLM-Wiki Pattern — Compounding Persistent Knowledge with Ollama+Obsidian Synergy
compact_cadence_reconciled: P1 has 4 units (02/03/04/04B) so compact slips from after:03 to after:04B. P2 has 3 units (05/06/07) so compact stays after:07. Fixes Agent D contradiction #4.
description: Adopt Andrej Karpathy's LLM-Wiki pattern across PRISM. Replace stateless RAG with a compounding LLM-maintained markdown wiki. Ollama owns ~70-80% of maintenance (free); Claude reserved for synthesis and contradiction resolution. Wiki is canonical persistence layer surviving compaction, multi-chat handoffs, and session boundaries. Reuses 16 existing engines wholesale (4 Obsidian, 9 Ollama/AI, 3 knowledge). Adds 5 new engines + 1 dispatcher + 4 hooks + 4 scripts + 7 skills. Vault: H:/prism/knowledge (existing — no migration). Post-bootstrap: 30-50% session token reduction.
goals: Replace RAG-on-every-query with persistent compounding wiki maintained incrementally
Wire Ollama for free wiki maintenance: summarization, drafting, lint candidate detection
Establish wiki/index.md and wiki/log.md as canonical multi-chat coordination artifacts
Build WikiLintEngine that cross-checks claims against physics constants and tribal tips
Cut session startup token cost 30-50% by replacing full digest reads with targeted wiki page loads
File every PRISM AI/AGI/DL output back as wiki pages so insights compound instead of evaporating
Codify the protocol in WIKI_SCHEMA.md so all 6 concurrent chats + Codex + Ollama agents follow same rules

units.title: PRE-FOUNDATION — Stop Hook Re-Registration + Build Cache Repair (gates all downstream work)
units.rationale: Agent 15 audit (score 28/100) found 33 orphaned Stop hooks, 19 silently disabled via DISABLED_TOKEN_REDUX_2026_04_23 marker, and only 1 of 6 registered Stop hooks actually blocks. always-build-guard.mjs promised in MEMORY.md is unwired. Builds are NOT bulletproof. This is a PRE-EXISTING LIVE BUG that affects ALL downstream wiki work — every wiki engine commit could ship broken without a blocking gate. Must repair BEFORE U-WIKI01 starts.
units.description: (1) Audit every stop_on_*.mjs file in .claude/hooks/ — list orphans not in settings.json. (2) USER REVIEW + APPROVAL (do NOT auto-register without user input — risk of breaking active sessions if a hook is buggy). (3) Re-register approved orphan Stop hooks in settings.json with continueOnError:false where correctness-critical. (4) Audit the 19 DISABLED_TOKEN_REDUX_2026_04_23 short-circuits — for each, document WHY it was disabled, then USER APPROVAL re-enables correctness-critical ones (per memory feedback_dont_soften_completeness_gates.md). (5) Repair build cache: `npm run build` and assert mcp-server/dist/index.cjs exists. (6) Add an allowlist to .claude/helpers/apply-hook-fixes.mjs so build/wiki-correctness Stop hooks are EXCLUDED from future token-redux disabling.

units.title: WikiLintEngine — Safety-Aware Health Check
units.rationale: Biggest gap in existing infra. Cross-checking wiki claims against physics constants is safety-adjacent — Opus design warranted.
units.description: Find: orphan pages, broken cross-refs, stale claims (page mtime older than source mtime), missing concepts (mentioned ≥3× but no page), and — uniquely — wiki-vs-physics-constants drift (e.g. tribal page asserting kc1.1 P=2000 when canonical is 1800). Outputs to lint-reports/YYYY-MM-DD.md.
entry_conditions: Lint test fixture vault prepared with 5 deliberate violations
exit_conditions: Detects orphan pages with 100% recall on fixture vault (all 5 deliberate violations caught)
Cross-checks every wiki page mentioning a physics constant against src/physics/constants.ts; flags drift ≥2% from canonical
Routes orphan/stale candidate detection to Ollama; reserves Claude for contradiction resolution suggestions
Outputs lint-reports/YYYY-MM-DD.md with severity prefix '[CRITICAL|MAJOR|MINOR]'
Test: deliberate kc1.1 P=2000 in fixture page (canonical 1800, ~11% drift) → flagged as CRITICAL
Test: deliberate kc1.1 P=1840 in fixture page (canonical 1800, +2.2% drift) → flagged as MINOR (just over ±2% threshold)
Test: kc1.1 P=1815 (+0.83%) → NOT flagged (under ±2% threshold)
Test: orphan page with zero inbound [[wikilinks]] → flagged as MAJOR
WikiLintEngine MUST `import { KC11, TAYLOR_C, TAYLOR_N } from "../physics/constants.js"` — NOT read constants.ts as text
Drift threshold: ±2% canonical floor; severity scaling: 2-5%=MINOR, 5-10%=MAJOR, >10%=CRITICAL
Tests use ±2% tolerance on physics drift detection (no toBeGreaterThan(0))
Coverage ≥90%

abort_criteria: Lint misses any of 5 deliberate violations (recall < 100%)
False-positive rate on clean fixture vault > 5% (exit-condition match)
Physics drift threshold not measurable: any test uses tolerance > ±2% (must be exact ±2% per severity scale)
WikiLintEngine.ts contains inline numeric kc1.1/Taylor values (constants-checker hook blocks)
Engine doesn't import KC11/TAYLOR_C/TAYLOR_N from src/physics/constants.ts
Engine doesn't fall back to Claude when Ollama unreachable (degradation test must verify)

four_loop.build: Implement 5 lint categories with Ollama-routed candidate detection
four_loop.scrutinize: /safety-audit drift detection threshold; /algorithm-inspect orphan algo complexity
four_loop.gap_fill: /test all 5 fixture violations; verify recall = 100%; add edge cases (NaN, missing files)
four_loop.tie_up: Verify physics-agent hook satisfied; coverage report

deliverables.description: 5-category lint with safety-aware physics constant cross-check
5 fixture violation cases; ±2% physics drift tolerance; orphan recall=100%
